statement: A typed-client write is sent only after every fact has absolute URI identities, a supported recursively tagged value, and a boolean retraction state; an invalid draft is rejected locally.

frames.note: Normalizes omitted retraction flags and parses the complete fact batch before HTTP.
Requires a non-empty batch and parses every fact draft.
Parses source/entity/field URIs, typed value, and retraction flag.
Validates supported tags, nested shape, URI references, dates, bytes, and integer values.

consequence: Malformed or non-canonical data cannot be mistaken for a valid client-side graph write.
